easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause a noncreature artifact to enter under your control.
description:
Cause a noncreature artifact to enter under your control.
When the artifact enters as an Equipment, either because it is an Equipment or due to Bludgeon Brawl, its living weapon ability given to it by Ekthi triggers, creating a Clue token rather than a Phyrexian Germ due to Flitwing.
Repeat step 2.
